shared_elements: hieroglyphic-type sign repertoire (birds, seated figures, geometric signs) in ordered lines/columns
division of the surface into horizontal registers/lines
low-relief carved figures with text filling the field around them
justification: Both surfaces combine profile human figures rendered in shallow relief with dense rows of the same distinctive small pictorial sign repertoire (birds, seated persons, loaves and vessels) arranged in ruled lines, and both place a small figural/offering scene above or beside blocks of that script — an arbitrary and conventional combination unlikely to arise independently. The main difference in depicted content is proportion and emphasis: A is dominated by a multi-register figural tableau of facing figures with offering stands, while B is overwhelmingly a text field with only a tiny figural vignette at the top.
